7 انعقر He (a camel, and a horse, [&c.,]) [became hocked, houghed, or hamstrung; had his hock-tendon laid bare;] had his legs struck [or cut] with a sword. (S.) [See 1.] ―
-b2- It (a camel's or a horse's back) became galled by the saddle; as also ↓ اعتقر . (S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
